assetSummary.method: Sharp WebP re-encode with effort 6; decorative images resized only when wider than 1600px, without enlargement; same filenames and extensions retained.

unchangedAssets.reason: Portrait pixels and alpha were preserved exactly; small readable project captures were not blindly recompressed.

componentChanges: Hero background now uses low fetch priority; the main hero portrait is the only home image using Next preload and uses readable quality 85.
Below-fold About, Identity, Connect, featured cards, more-project cards, project-stack cards, and row thumbnails are explicitly lazy-loaded.
Decorative backgrounds use low fetch priority and final quality 60; screenshot-like project media and portraits use quality 85.
BrowserFrame accepts the new preload prop while retaining the priority prop as a compatibility alias; CaseStudyMedia now calls preload.

ProjectsIndex keeps accessible inline mobile thumbnails but mounts only the currently requested full-resolution hover preview after the first fine-pointer hover. GSAP hover behavior and no-JS/touch row content remain intact.
ProjectsIndex imports Flip from components/motion/flip so the shared GSAP module can remain lighter.

visualSpotChecks: contact-moon.webp retained its composition after re-encode
torii-foreground.webp retained transparent artwork after resize/re-encode
